def: rust (as if emitted by metals); also venom (as emitted by serpents)

occurrences.text: Their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips:
Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
